headline: Plan for Small Car Parks and Fragile Landscapes
reservation: No entry permit is required, but car parks at Gwaun Hepste and Cwm Porth are small and often full before midday. Most parking locations are cash-only, so bring change. Check official social media channels for real-time congestion updates before departing.

days.title: Four Falls Trail

stops.name: Sgwd Clun-Gwyn
stops.detail: Reachable in 30-40 minutes from the trailhead, these upper falls feature a dramatic broad drop.

stops.name: Sgwd y Pannwr
stops.detail: Follow the river trail for another 30 minutes to reach this cascade, historically used for washing wool.

stops.name: Sgwd yr Eira
stops.detail: Continue for a final 30-minute hike to reach the 'waterfall of snow'.

days.driving: Allow time for narrow single-track lanes; parking is limited to designated areas.
days.note: A suggestion for a steady pace: terrain is uneven and not suitable for buggies or wheelchairs.

intel.title: Cash and Congestion
intel.text: Car parks like Cwm Porth are small and typically reach capacity before noon. Ensure you have physical coins as most sites are cash only.

intel.title: Challenging Terrain
intel.text: Waterfalls are not located near car parks and require long walks on uneven ground. Follow one-way advisory signage to protect the fragile environment.

intel.title: Early Arrival Highly Recommended
intel.text: High visitor demand causes significant congestion on weekends and holidays. Aim to arrive early to secure a legal parking spot and avoid fines.

intel.title: Verify Local Services
intel.text: The evidence does not specify fuel locations; travelers should fill their tanks in larger towns before entering the narrow lanes of the National Park.

intel.title: Connectivity Status Unknown
intel.text: Evidence does not confirm mobile signal strength in the gorges. Download maps offline and check park social media for updates before arriving.

plan.arrival: Collect your vehicle and pick up supplies in a nearby town like Neath; proceed to Gwaun Hepste or Cwm Porth to secure parking.
plan.vehicle: Compact cars are highly recommended for narrow, single-track lanes with few passing places; check rental agreements for rural road restrictions.
plan.goldenHour: Sunset views are seasonal at the gorges; verify local conditions as the deep wooded valleys lose light early.
